scope: One-off read of current native geometry and an illustrative dry-air tube calculation; no CAD or printer changes.

B_vent_to_ambient_clearance_witness.route: Across nominal gap above B lid to draw-conduit annulus
Through B draw-conduit annulus following its two native bends

witness_scope: Route crosses the nominal gap above reservoir A cap, then its draw-conduit annulus. Nominal clearances do not establish as-built conductance, filter performance or a sealed filtered-air boundary. Foam is absent from the reservoir pockets; cap foam remains outside conduit walls.

air_tube_estimate.basis: Current KPHM600 recorded maximum nominal liquid flow; near-atmospheric displaced air volume equals liquid volume.
air_tube_estimate.method: Hagen-Poiseuille for fully developed laminar dry air, negligible compression at this pressure drop.
air_tube_estimate.exclusions: Membrane, connectors, bends, liquid slugs and syrup contamination; not measured installed performance.

customer_outcome: Easy tube insertion and depth adjustment, useful local tube grip and splash obstruction, with an explicit bidirectional reservoir air path independent of casing clearances.

physical_observation.quote: So the 1/4 tubes do insert easily into the lid here
physical_observation.assessment: Reported easy insertion; no tube-slip failure, numerical pull force or assembled vent-flow result reported.

tube_grip_candidate.status: Evaluation only; no CAD, printable part or running-print change.
tube_grip_candidate.shape: Spool-shaped TPU with a cylindrical waist and 45-degree flares at both ends. Matching countersinks in the PETG port seat both TPU ends flush. The lid and insert are designed as a pair.
tube_grip_candidate.outer_fit_purpose: Capture the insert in the port and obstruct the direct splash gap.
tube_grip_candidate.inner_fit_purpose: Hand-adjustable tube grip, particularly to preserve dip-tube depth during assembly.
tube_grip_candidate.retention_elsewhere: The remote valve/fitting push-fit retains the tube at its connection; the current lid and casing bores guide it with clearance and supply no specified axial grip.
tube_grip_candidate.design_basis: Use the actual tube fit and complete 11 mm port/boss span. A short gripping band with lead-ins can limit assembly drag; exact interference, print fit and retention remain unselected.
tube_grip_candidate.flange_clearance_resolution: Both objects are printed and controlled. Matching countersinks make the insert flush; nominal 0.4 mm clearance above the present lid is a design datum, not a reason to reject the proposed interface.
tube_grip_candidate.scope: No pressure-seal, retention-load, creep-life or splash qualification is inferred.

vent_evaluation.present_path: Headspace -> side-slotted baffle ->5 mm bore ->membrane pocket ->nominal 0.4 mm gap under casing floor ->tube-conduit annulus ->outside air.
vent_evaluation.direction: The open geometry and a dry hydrophobic membrane permit inward and outward flow; no check valve is present.
vent_evaluation.bypass: The current loose tube bores also connect headspace to conduit annuli without passing through the membrane.
vent_evaluation.recommendation: Provide one protected bidirectional vent tube per reservoir to outside the insulation, retaining the splash baffle and a sheltered dry hydrophobic filter at the external end. Keep this air route independent of tube grip and warm-side casing closures.
vent_evaluation.sizing: 4 mm OD /2.5 mm ID existing neoFlo stock is a plausible short-route candidate at the recorded nominal KPHM600 0.6 L/min flow; the calculation excludes membrane and installed restrictions.
vent_evaluation.limit: No installed conductance, filter permeability, syrup-wetting or fouling-life test establishes performance of the current assembly.

sources.scope: Air enters as tanks empty and exits as they fill; size using the larger fill/draw rate with equal air volume.
General bidirectional membrane-vent mechanism; not the specification of our purchased LVDALAB disc.
neoFlo 4 mm OD, 2.5 mm ID and 25 mm minimum bend radius.
Recorded KPHM600 nominal 380-600 mL/min flow basis.
